full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 51 of 1983 in the Second Court of Subordinate Judge (now Joint District Judge), Patuakhali, which was transferred to the Court of Subordinate Judge, Barguna for declaration of title and confirmation of possession alternatively for recovery of possession and also for further declaration that the alleged auction sale in Certificate Case No. 220A/30-31 and auction sale dated 25.02.1933 were fraudulent, void, illegal, without jurisdiction and not binding upon plaintiff Nos. 1-3 and 6-10. The plaintiffs' case, in short, is that 39.33 acres of land along with tenanted 1.31 acres of land, in total 40.65 acres of land of P.S. Khatian No. 72, R.S. Khatian No. 118 of No. 8 Kalibari Mouza belonged to Idris, Jedon, Moina Bibi, Apter, Mayajan, Hamejuddin, Moijuddin, Saden Ali, Addeluddin, Sundar, Afser, Ajim Uddin and Abdul in different shares. After that, Idris died leaving behind as his brother's son Jedon as only heir. Moina Bibi died leaving behind her only son, Jedon as her heir and Jedon died leaving behind a son plaintiff No. 1 and a daughter Komertoban as his only heir. Mayajan Bibi died leaving behind only son, plaintiff No. 5. Moijuddin died leaving behind wife, plaintiff No. 10 and four sons, plaintiff Nos. 6-9. Sundar died leaving behind plaintiff Nos. 2 and 3. Ajim Ali died leaving behind 2 sons, plaintiff Nos. 11 and 12 and a wife plaintiff No. 13 and Abdul died leaving behind only son Sonamuddin and thereafter, Sonamuddin died leaving behind a son, plaintiff No. 14 and three daughters, plaintiff Nos. 15-17 and a wife, plaintiff No. 18 Afser died leaving behind a cousin Ajim Ali as his only heir. Thus, all the plaintiffs became the owners of 12 annas, 12 gondas, one kara and one kranti share in the land of said P.s. Khatian No. 72 which is the suit land. The lands of said P.S. khatian No. 72 were wrongly recorded in S.A. Khatian Nos. 58, 59, 91, 219, 220, 231 and 262 in the names of the defendants and their predecessors, instead of the plaintiffs and their predecessors. None of the defendants had/have possession in any portion of the suit land and it is the plaintiffs' predecessors and then the plaintiffs who have got exclusive possession therein for more than 12 years. But because of the wrong recording of the suit land in the name of the defendants a cloud was created over their title. The cause of action for the suit arose on 17.04.1982 corresponding to the first part of Baishak, 1389 B.S. when the defendants claimed the suit property on the basis of the said wrong recording. Hence the plaintiff was constrained to file the suit.
